about: Rank checks of the playgroup prediction model (precon_predict.json) under each pilot: repair plan WS11 task 11, decision 19. One record per check, appended by the study's reader (studies/rank_check_r1/read_rank_check.py --write-record) and never edited afterwards. GET /results/{file}/prediction reads the latest record whose pilot equals the run's pilot id (engine/pilot.py) and whose model equals the served model's fingerprint (predict.model_fingerprint: a hash of the fitted parameters, so a refit needs its own check and a check of the old model neither withholds nor vouches for the new one): pass keeps the label, fail withholds the prediction for that pilot until the model is refit, no record keeps the label and says no check has been run. Fields: release, date, pilot, model, jar_sha, plan_version, metric, value, threshold, pass, n_decks, games, study, prereg_commit.
